name: Clockwork Ranger
description: A construct made from gears and metal with an attachment built into it's arm that allows the firing of powerful projectiles at a long distance. Clockwork creatures are powered by an internal conduit which can focus beams of energy to deal damage.

actions.name: Metal Fist
actions.description: The Clockwork Cleanser strikes a creature with it's metal fist, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Damage Control
actions.description: In response to taking damage, the Clockwork Cleanser shuts down. At the end of it's next turn, if it still has health remaining, it explodes, dealing physical and fire damage in a 3 unit radius, moving any large or small creatures within the radius outside it.

actions.name: Snipe
actions.description: The Clockwork Ranger makes an attack with their crossbow attachment at a creature between 6 and 20 units, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Assisted Aim
actions.description: The Clockwork Ranger uses their internal mechanisms to aim their crossbow attachment. Their next Snipe Action on this turn gains a 1d4 bonus to the attack modifier and 1d10 bonus damage.

traits.name: Overcharge
traits.description: If the Clockwork Ranger takes more than 20 lightning damage after mitigation, it becomes stunned. If it takes more than 30 lightning damage, it is destroyed.
